decisions.reason: The earmold is close to the firm's established hearing-care offer, the industry is growing and the firm has slack, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources, though its thin web presence makes it somewhat more vulnerable.
The individual EARsleeve has its own web page and extends the firm's core custom-earmold competence, which suggests results meet aspirations, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's established dental equipment line, has dedicated web presentation, and in a growing market with organisational slack there is little reason to drop it.
